bug_semantics: CWE-598: /refresh on keyserver and telemetry FastAPI routes took refresh_token via Query(...), putting the secret in URLs (access logs, proxies, Referer, browser history). CVE.org CVE-2026-74880 is PUBLISHED (same issue as GHSA-4rh7-jwg9-m28m).
flaw_origin: cdc9c7d814915a9a2c568987b7bcc14f3b7cf533 (feat: Reduce JWT expiry and implement refresh tokens) first added /refresh with refresh_token: str = Query(...) in openssl_encrypt_server/modules/{keyserver,telemetry}/routes.py. Parent e5961e7a72b3e37bad6012ff2c06aeacefb85aca had neither refresh handler.

reasoning: The vuln is accepting refresh tokens as GET/query strings on /refresh, not JWT itself. BIC is the first public commit that wrote those Query sinks; Claude co-authored that object, so AI authored the first-write. Advisory is published, not withdrawn. Direct fix SHA is the telemetry POST-body commit cited by GHSA-4rh7.
